name: NomadMD Segment v2 Tracking Plan — browser stream
description: NomadMD Segment integration v2, browser-stream events (schema_version 2.0) — attach to your JavaScript source. Matches the "Segment v2 — Event & Schema Reference" documentation. Import into your workspace via Segment's Public API (Tracking Plans), or use as a JSON Schema reference. Generated — do not edit.

signup_marketplace_id.description: brand first signed up through — set once, NOT a 'belongs to'

client_profile_id.description: primary care record (legacy typo clientProfielId fixed)

client_profile_ids.description: all care records under the account

package_credits_remaining.description: current unexpired credit balance on the account — point-in-time state for segmentation (churn-risk/upsell audiences); the ledger is the events (grants on Membership Started/Renewed + Package Purchased, burns on Package Credit Redeemed). Brand-scoped at the receiving source: credits from THIS brand's packages only

lifetime_appointments.description: Account-grain lifetime appointment count, computed within your brand only.

lifetime_revenue.description: Account-grain lifetime revenue, computed within your brand only.

is_new_customer.description: POINT-IN-TIME STATE: lifetime_appointments == 0. False immediately after the first booking — BY DESIGN. 'Was this customer new at the time of appointment X' is answered by the EVENT properties is_new_customer / prior_appointment_count, never by this trait

jsonSchema.description: First route hit for a brand in a session
ProcedureDialog opens for a catalog item

has_availability.description: false rows are the supply-gap signal

checkout_session_id.description: client-minted uuid — stamped on every checkout event

jsonSchema.description: Auth success — triggers identify() + alias(anonymousId -> mu_) on client
New marketplace_user registered — exactly ONE group-scoped identify(); signup_marketplace_id trait set once

Booking submitted — the canonical conversion. Fires at request submission as booked value; kept honest by Order Updated / Order Cancelled, with cash truth in the payment-ledger events. Also emitted standalone for membership/package purchases and renewals (order_id membership_<id> / package_<id>) — never doubled when bundled inside a booking checkout.

created_via.description: Origin surface of the creation: consumer checkout, admin dashboard, field app, or API.

created_by.description: actor TYPE who created it — patient for self-serve, staff type otherwise; complements created_via (surface)

created_by_user_id.description: staff users.id when staff-created; omitted for patient self-serve — the event userId already identifies the creator

checkout_session_id.description: PRESENT AND NULLABLE on the server stream from day one (phase 1 emits null until the client pass-through ships in phase 2); non-null on client stream

amount_due_now.description: what checkout displayed as due at booking

prior_appointment_count.description: Prior appointments for this customer at your brand, counted before the current one.

is_group_appointment.description: true when this order books >1 patient on a shared group checkout; server always emits

group_id.description: UUID shared by the group's appointments; null for solo

group_size.description: patients on the shared checkout (1 for solo); revenue/total are the group total, not per-member

checkout_session_id.description: null on server stream until phase-2 pass-through, same as Order Completed
